arguments.sql_query:
SELECT TOP 50 c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.vocabulary_id, c.concept_code, COUNT(*) AS n_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT m.person_id) AS n_patients
FROM omop.measurement m
JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = m.measurement_concept_id
WHERE c.domain_id = 'Measurement'
  AND (LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%helicobacter pylori%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%h. pylori%')
GROUP BY c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.vocabulary_id, c.concept_code
ORDER BY n_orders DESC, n_patients DESC

SELECT TOP 50 c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.vocabulary_id, c.concept_code, COUNT(*) AS n_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_id) AS n_patients
FROM omop.procedure_occurrence p
JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = p.procedure_concept_id
WHERE (LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%helicobacter pylori%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%h. pylori%')
GROUP BY c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.vocabulary_id, c.concept_code
ORDER BY n_orders DESC, n_patients DESC

SELECT TOP 50 m.measurement_source_value, COUNT(*) AS n_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT m.person_id) AS n_patients
FROM omop.measurement m
WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(m.measurement_source_value,'')) LIKE '%pylori%'
   OR LOWER(COALESCE(m.measurement_source_value,'')) LIKE '%helicobacter%'
GROUP BY m.measurement_source_value
ORDER BY n_orders DESC, n_patients DESC

Grouping related OMOP measurement concepts, the three most frequently ordered noninvasive H. pylori test types were:

| Rank | Test type | Orders | Patients |
|---:|---|---:|---:|
| 1 | H. pylori antibody / serology | 57,072 | ~36,?* |
| 2 | Stool antigen immunoassay | 18,891 | 15,516 |
| 3 | Urea breath test | 7,417 | ~3,549* |

\*Patient counts across grouped concepts may overlap, so summed patient counts are approximate unless de-duplicated across concepts.

Top contributing concepts were:
- `Measurement of Helicobacter pylori antibody` — 30,391 orders
- `H. pylori IgG Ab [Units/volume] in Serum by Immunoassay` — 24,722 orders
- `H. pylori Ag [Presence] in Stool by Immunoassay` — 18,891 orders
- Breath-test concepts together — 5,119 + 2,298 orders

I excluded invasive/biopsy-associated tests such as culture and rapid urease/CLO where identifiable.
